verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh kî- ṭō·wḇ kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD for He is good . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū lê·lō·hê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Give thanks to the God of gods . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵ֣י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū la·’ă·ḏō·nê hā·’ă·ḏō·nîm kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·lām
verses.literal: Give thanks to the Lord of lords . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְבַדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעֹ֘שֵׂ֤ה גְּדֹל֣וֹת נִפְלָא֣וֹת חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lə·ḇad·dōw kî lə·‘ō·śêh gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He alone . . . does great wonders His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה לְעֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: biṯ·ḇū·nāh lə·‘ō·śêh haš·šā·ma·yim kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: By His insight He made the heavens . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְרֹקַ֣ע הָ֭אָרֶץ עַל־ הַמָּ֑יִם כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lə·rō·qa‘ hā·’ā·reṣ ‘al- ham·mā·yim kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He spread out the earth upon the waters . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְ֭עֹשֵׂה גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י אוֹרִ֣ים חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ō·śêh gə·ḏō·lîm kî ’ō·w·rîm ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He made the great . . . lights His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: אֶת־ הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת בַּיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- haš·še·meš lə·mem·še·leṯ bay·yō·wm kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: - the sun to rule the day . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: אֶת־ הַיָּרֵ֣חַ וְ֭כוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁל֣וֹת בַּלָּ֑יְלָה כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- hay·yā·rê·aḥ wə·ḵō·w·ḵā·ḇîm lə·mem·šə·lō·wṯ bal·lā·yə·lāh kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: - the moon and stars to govern the night . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְמַכֵּ֣ה בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֖י מִ֭צְרַיִם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lə·mak·kêh biḇ·ḵō·w·rê·hem kî miṣ·ra·yim ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He struck down the firstborn . . . of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וַיּוֹצֵ֣א מִתּוֹכָ֑ם כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·w·ṣê mit·tō·w·ḵām kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: and brought Israel out from among them . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: חֲ֭זָקָה בְּיָ֣ד נְטוּיָ֑ה כִּ֖י וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ḥă·zā·qāh bə·yāḏ nə·ṭū·yāh kî ū·ḇiz·rō·w·a‘ ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: with a mighty hand and an outstretched . . . arm His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְגֹזֵ֣ר ס֭וּף יַם־ לִגְזָרִ֑ים כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lə·ḡō·zêr sūp̄ yam- liḡ·zā·rîm kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He divided the Red Sea in two . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וְהֶעֱבִ֣יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·ḇîr yiś·rā·’êl bə·ṯō·w·ḵōw kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: and led Israel through the midst . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וְנִ֘עֵ֤ר פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְחֵיל֣וֹ ס֑וּף כִּ֖י בְיַם־ חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: wə·ni·‘êr par·‘ōh wə·ḥê·lōw sūp̄ kî ḇə·yam- ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red . . . Sea His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְמוֹלִ֣יךְ עַ֭מּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lə·mō·w·lîḵ ‘am·mōw bam·miḏ·bār kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He led His people through the wilderness . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְ֭מַכֵּה גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י מְלָכִ֣ים חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lə·mak·kêh gə·ḏō·lîm kî mə·lā·ḵîm ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He struck down great . . . kings His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג אַדִּירִ֑ים כִּ֖י מְלָכִ֣ים חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: way·ya·hă·rōḡ ’ad·dî·rîm kî mə·lā·ḵîm ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: and slaughtered mighty . . . kings His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְ֭סִיחוֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֑י כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lə·sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Sihon king of the Amorites . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ hab·bā·šān kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: and Og king of Bashan . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan ’ar·ṣām lə·na·ḥă·lāh kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: and He gave their land as an inheritance . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: נַ֭חֲלָה עַבְדּ֑וֹ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: na·ḥă·lāh ‘aḇ·dōw lə·yiś·rā·’êl kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: a heritage to His servant Israel . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: זָ֣כַר לָ֑נוּ שֶׁ֭בְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵar lā·nū bə·šip̄·lê·nū kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He remembered us in our low estate . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וַיִּפְרְקֵ֥נוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·rə·qê·nū miṣ·ṣā·rê·nū kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: and freed us from our enemies . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לְכָל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: nō·ṯên le·ḥem lə·ḵāl bā·śār kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He gives food to every creature . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לְאֵ֣ל הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū lə·’êl haš·šā·mā·yim kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Give thanks to the God of heaven . . . His loving devotion endures forever
